  "first_3_seconds": "A heavy door bangs open. Juliana looks up startled. Alexander stands in the dark doorway, panting, hand pressed to a blood-soaked chest. He is bleeding heavily.",
  "ending": "Juliana stares in horror at Alexander's bare torso, revealing deep battle scars and fresh lacerations across his chest and ribs as she whispers 'Dear God.'",

    "The visual of the wound takes until second 30 to reveal, which is very late for a 37-second clip; the first 25 seconds are mostly dialogue about a 'scratch' that feels like filler.",
    "The transition from 'blood on coat' to 'bare chest' relies on the viewer waiting through a long argument about removing the shirt, which risks drop-off before the payoff.",
    "No clear antagonist or immediate threat is shown yet, only injury; the stakes feel internal (pain) rather than external (danger) until the very end."
